integrity: A direct coefficient-counting checker and independent adjacency enumeration are included. General matching-polytope adjacency is prior work, not claimed original.
scientific_limitations: Counts incident invariant curves at torus-fixed points, not all singular strata. Unindexed equivalent enumerations remain possible. All-dimensional argument symbolic, supported by finite checks through n=8.
title: Cycle-type local curve spectra of derangement-polytope toric varieties
